appDescription: Save local snapshots of vehicle observations and location through voice requests without opening a screen.

function.name: CAPTURE_RECORD
function.description: Save the current vehicle observations and location when voice recording is permitted.

requestId.description: An optional stable identifier for retrying the same request.

function.name: ADD_RECORD_MEMO
function.description: Add a memo to the record that was just saved, while the save confirmation is still active.

recordId.description: The identifier returned by the capture action, if known.

memoToken.description: The one-time token returned by the capture action, if known.

memo.description: The memo to attach to the record.
